meta.values_precision: sRGB matrices are published as exact rationals; Bradford matrices as 64-bit decimal literals (up to 17 significant digits).

tolerance.rationale: Each case pairs a published forward matrix with its published inverse. Our Matrix3::inverse() of the forward matrix must match the published inverse. Both are float64 renderings of exact values; inversion of these well-conditioned matrices costs ~30 flops, so the expected error is below 1e-14. 1e-12 (absolute, element values <= ~3.3) leaves a 100x margin while still detecting any real defect.

cases.name: linear Bradford chromatic adaptation D65 -> D50
